name: BA School of Business and Finance (UL FinTech Business School)
summary: Business school of the University of Latvia in Riga; three English-taught professional bachelor's in business process management, FinTech and finance.

ib.text: No IB-specific page: the Diploma counts as a general secondary diploma. Each degree sets minimum grades on Latvia's 10-point scale; English B2 shows on your certificate or via IELTS 6.0.

lastYear.text: EU/EEA by 16 Aug; state-funded places by 5 July

programmes.name: Business Process Management
programmes.about: Managerial training for fast-changing workplaces: organisational management, leadership, finance and business process management, with creative project methods and real company challenges; qualification Enterprise Manager.

needs.note: Final maths grade of at least 4 on Latvia's 10-point scale

programmes.selectionNote: Fee-paying places only: maths grade 4 of 10 and English B2, then an online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Finance Management Information Systems
programmes.about: FinTech joining software engineering and financial management, taught jointly with Riga Technical University; graduates get the qualification Programming Engineer.

needs.note: Final maths grade of at least 4 on Latvia's 10-point scale

programmes.selectionNote: State-funded places ranked on English 40%, Maths 40%, average 20%; fee places need maths 4 of 10 and an interview. 2026 criteria.

programmes.name: International Finance
programmes.about: Double-degree programme with SBS Swiss Business School on international business and finance, for careers in banking, finance, entrepreneurship or marketing; qualification Financier.

needs.note: Final maths grade of at least 4 on Latvia's 10-point scale

programmes.selectionNote: Funded places ranked on English 60%, Maths 12%, average 20%, entrance exam 8%; fee places need maths 4 of 10 and an interview. 2026 criteria.

notes: The school joined the University of Latvia on 1 September 2025 and now carries its FinTech Business School name; it applies through the university's application portal.
EU/EEA citizens can compete for the few state-funded places; all other places are fee-paying and cost the same or less for EU/EEA citizens than for other nationalities.
Finance Management Information Systems is a joint programme with Riga Technical University, which lists it too.
